findings.title: dir-tree fallback builds a shell command with eval from overview inputs
findings.evidence: shared/skills/overview/SKILL.md:52 requires running dir-tree.sh with the selected project path; shared/skills/overview/scripts/dir-tree.sh:9 reads PROJECT_DIR from argv, shared/skills/overview/scripts/dir-tree.sh:10 reads DEPTH from argv, and shared/skills/overview/scripts/dir-tree.sh:26 executes eval find with those values and dynamic EXCLUDES in the fallback path.

evidence_checks.claim: The overview workflow requires invoking dir-tree.sh with the selected project path.
dir-tree.sh reads the project path from argv.
The fallback path constructs and executes a shell command with eval.

required_claims: The overview workflow passes user-selected project path input to dir-tree.sh.
dir-tree.sh builds its fallback find invocation through shell eval using argv-derived values.
The script does not validate or escape those argv-derived values before eval.
claim_review.refutation_check: shared/skills/overview/scripts/dir-tree.sh:11 only checks that PROJECT_DIR is a directory; shared/skills/overview/scripts/dir-tree.sh:16 uses tree when available, but the eval fallback at shared/skills/overview/scripts/dir-tree.sh:26 remains active when tree is absent.

severity_calibration.team_use_impact: A required scan helper can execute unintended shell fragments in fallback environments, affecting safe team use for a skill that accepts a user-supplied project path.
severity_calibration.rationale: This is not inflated to P0 because the unsafe branch is conditional on tree being unavailable and no exploit payload was executed in this audit; it is still P1 because it affects runtime command safety in a required scan step.

findings.impact: A required scan helper can execute unintended shell fragments in fallback environments, affecting safe team use and making the user-supplied project path an unsafe runtime input.
findings.verification_hint: Replace eval with an argument-array or loop-based find implementation, validate DEPTH as a positive integer, preserve ignore semantics, then test paths containing spaces and shell metacharacters.
